items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases are blocked; ordinary reversible growth is conditional. Fleet-doctor has no run or results, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing evidence is not a clean bill of health. Risk severity is high for public exposure or security-sensitive releases and medium for bounded changes adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: continue only the existing read-only security evidence matrix; preserve private and preview-only launch gates; do not deploy, requeue, change permissions or configuration, access credentials or private containers, add dependencies, expand telemetry, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not request duplicate telemetry, access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct external outreach.
